title: Pass Metadata
description: Machine-readable record for one AI assistant pass

pass_id.description: Full PASS_ID stem e.g. 26-05-09_P38_queue-prefix-selection. Never abbreviated.

pass_name.description: Human-readable pass name e.g. Queue Prefix Selection

model.description: Model string used e.g. gpt-5.5 or claude-sonnet-4-6

agent_md_present.description: Whether AGENT.md was present at the project root when this pass ran

schema_present.description: Whether metadata-schema.json was present at the project root when this pass ran

gitignore_correct.description: Whether build-report-logs/ was in .gitignore when this pass ran

build_result.description: Build outcome for implementation passes. null for documentation/workflow passes.

files_created.description: Files created by this pass only

files_modified.description: Files modified by this pass only

pre_existing_dirty_files.description: Files already modified before this pass began. Listed separately.

behavior_changes.description: Optional. Structured list of behavior changes made this pass.

known_limitations.description: Optional. Limitations or intentional non-changes documented this pass.

duration_seconds.description: Elapsed pass time in seconds. Calculated from LAUNCH_TIME and COMPLETE_TIME in the meta file by scripts/ai-post-pass.zsh. Agent always writes null.

total_tokens_used.description: Total tokens consumed. Extracted from the clean log by scripts/ai-post-pass.zsh. Agent always writes null. Do not estimate.
